visual_direction.perspective: subtly oppressive asymmetric framing, low or off-axis camera, corridor feels slightly too long, doorframes create visual pressure; retain believable architecture
visual_direction.texture: rough engraved linework, visibly dry charcoal strokes, damp stains, peeling plaster, dust suspended in air, aged scratched surfaces

visual_direction.anomaly: only subtle ambiguous irregularities in shadow, framing, or environmental detail; never a visible supernatural entity
